$$
\begin{aligned}-\frac{1}{2}b & =-\frac{1}{2}[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ -4 \\ 6 \\ 8 \\ 0\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-\frac{1}{2}\cdot (-2) \\ -\frac{1}{2}\cdot (-4) \\ -\frac{1}{2}\cdot 6 \\ -\frac{1}{2}\cdot 8 \\ -\frac{1}{2}\cdot 0\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 2 \\ -3 \\ -4 \\ 0\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
